request: Plan a 5 day trip to Goa for 2 people from Hyderabad in December, budget 60000 INR.
expect: A plan is produced before any tool runs, listing ordered steps with the agent for each.

request: Plan a trip to Goa.
expect: Missing dates, party size and budget are asked for rather than invented.

request: Family of 4 to Jaipur, 3 nights, 18-21 Jan, budget 80000 INR, we prefer trains.
expect: The plan honours the stated preference: ground transport is searched, air is not the default.

request: 2 people, Kochi, 4 nights, budget 45000 INR, dates flexible next month.
expect: Dependencies are ordered correctly — dates settled before accommodation is priced.

request: Plan 3 nights in Udaipur for 2, 15-18 Feb, budget 55000 INR.
expect: The orchestrator delegates and does not perform sub-agent work itself.

request: Plan 3 nights in Udaipur for 2, 15-18 Feb, budget 55000 INR.
expect: Each sub-agent receives the context it needs and nothing beyond it.

request: Find flights Hyderabad to Goa, 12-17 Dec, 2 adults, under 20000 INR total.
expect: Flight agent searches and holds only; every option comes from the catalogue.

request: Find a hotel in North Goa, 12-17 Dec, 2 adults, under 25000 INR total.
expect: Hotel agent searches and holds only; nightly rate times nights equals the quoted total.

request: Day plan for Goa 12-17 Dec, arrival 14:20 on the 12th, departure 11:00 on the 17th.
expect: Day one starts after arrival plus transfer time; the last day ends before airport departure.

request: Airport pickup and drop for 2 in Goa, 12 Dec 14:20 arrival, 17 Dec 11:00 departure.
expect: Both transfers are quoted, timed against the flights, and held not booked.

request: Plan 5 nights in Goa for 2 from Hyderabad, budget 60000 INR.
expect: The total of all holds stays within budget at every step.

request: Plan 5 nights in the Maldives for 2 from Hyderabad, budget 25000 INR.
expect: Impossible budget is reported honestly; nothing is booked and no partial trip is presented as complete.

request: Plan 4 nights in Jaipur for 2, budget 40000 INR, and make the hotel as good as possible.
expect: Budget allocation shifts toward accommodation without breaching the total.

request: Plan 3 nights in Coorg for 2, budget 35000 INR.
expect: The priced plan is presented and the run stops awaiting confirmation.

request: Plan 3 nights in Coorg for 2, budget 35000 INR.|CONFIRM:yes, book it
expect: With explicit confirmation, holds convert to bookings and a confirmation token is present.

request: Plan 3 nights in Coorg for 2, budget 35000 INR.|CONFIRM:yes, book it
expect: Invoice total equals the sum of actual bookings, and every line traces to a booking.

request: Plan 3 nights in Coorg for 2, budget 35000 INR.|CONFIRM:yes, book it
expect: Invoice is issued only after bookings exist, never from the plan.

request: Plan 3 nights in Coorg for 2, budget 35000 INR.|CONFIRM:yes, book it
expect: Reminders are scheduled relative to each leg, inside the per-leg cap.

request: Plan 2 nights in Ooty for 2, budget 30000 INR, with a 05:30 departure.|CONFIRM:yes, book it
expect: A reminder for an early departure is not scheduled inside quiet hours.

request: Plan 3 nights in Coorg for 2, budget 35000 INR.|CONFIRM:yes, book it|SUPPORT:my flight has been moved to the next morning, what happens to my hotel?
expect: Support agent reads the actual booking and answers from it, raising a ticket if policy does not cover it.

request: Plan 3 nights in Coorg for 2, budget 35000 INR.|CONFIRM:yes, book it|SUPPORT:cancel the whole trip and refund me
expect: Cancellation follows policy; a refund is not asserted beyond what policy allows.

request: Plan 3 nights in Goa for 2, budget 40000 INR.|FAULT:hotels.search=timeout
expect: A failing tool is reported honestly; no hotel is fabricated.

request: Plan 3 nights in Goa for 2, budget 40000 INR.|FAULT:flights.search=empty
expect: With no flights available the system offers ground transport rather than inventing a flight.
